boundary_rationale: Onset: no formula device opens Ezek.45.1 ('and when you divide the land by lot' is a continuation clause, not a word-event, son-of-man address or messenger formula); the row follows directly after the pe recorded after Ezek.44.31. This is the held 44.31/45.1 question: the priests' portion at 44.28-31 is taken as the true close of the prior unit (its own pe is the nearest mark), and 45.1 is read as opening a new one on content grounds alone -- the sanctuary-and-prince land allotment, a distinct topic from priestly dues. The row covers the holy portion's dimensions (1-3), the priests' land (4), the Levites' land (5), the city's possession (6), and the prince's portion (7-8). Close: the samekh recorded after Ezek.45.8 gives this stretch a real parashah-marked close even though its onset carries none; the following verse, 45.9, opens with a fresh messenger formula on a different topic (weights and measures).
